## Problem / Motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Describe it.
Example: "The system currently depends on a PC for inference, which limits..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

## Affected Area

- [ ] Computer vision / gesture recognition (`src/gesture_recognition/`)
- [ ] Machine learning model / training (`src/training/`, `src/models/`)
- [ ] MQTT communication (`src/mqtt/`)
- [ ] Embedded firmware (`firmware/`)
- [ ] Hardware design (`hardware/`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository / DevOps (CI, templates, etc.)

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add mockups, references, links to similar implementations, or anything else
relevant. If this maps to an item already listed in
[Future Improvements](../../README.md#-future-improvements), please
reference it.
